description: The STREAM project publishes consumption, generation and flexibility forecasts for a photovoltaic and battery installation in its Spanish pilot. Zenodo lists one public 153 KB CSV under CC BY 4.0. The description identifies Time, lower and upper available-flexibility bounds and an ID distinguishing baseline, long-term-market and short-term-market cases. These forecast bands could be compared with simulated dispatch and congestion relief in a local electricity-grid model. They are model outputs, not measured delivered flexibility, and the provider does not state confidence-interval meaning or the method that produced the bounds. The landing page also omits units, forecast horizon, sample interval and error statistics. A modeller would need those details and the associated measured power series for quantitative validation. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this forecast file. The CSV was not downloaded; row structure and any consumption or generation fields beyond the public description remain unverified.
